about:
SAERTEX USA, LLC is headquartered in Huntersville, North Carolina. The company operates as the U.S. subsidiary of the global SAERTEX Group, a German-based producer of textile reinforcement materials for composite structures.

The company manufactures multiaxial and unidirectional non-crimp fabrics (NCF) from glass, carbon, aramid, and natural fibers, along with core materials such as SAERfoam and SAERcore. Its product portfolio encompasses more than 3,300 article constructions. SAERTEX supports customers from initial material development through series production, providing engineering services and a digital laminate calculator. The group operates 17 production and service locations across five continents.

SAERTEX serves the wind energy, aerospace, automotive, marine, mobility and transport, infrastructure and construction, sport and leisure, and pipe rehabilitation sectors. Documented projects include supplying reinforcement fabrics for CAPiTA snowboards, GATTO shipyard’s hybrid ferries, the Norman Foster Foundation’s roof in Madrid, Aventura Yachts catamarans, Steiner truck bodies, Ekin Muovi bus components, and Scania city buses.

The company emphasizes its global footprint and integrated service model—combining material development, processing expertise, and on-site technical support—as its primary differentiator, enabling customers to realize lightweight, durable composite structures.
